  • Typical starting MOQ: 100 pieces per design, subject to process.
  • About 7 days for a sample and about 15 days for bulk production after approval.

FAQ

Custom medal questions.

Common details for event medal production.

Can custom medals include ribbons?

Yes. Medals can be supplied with custom ribbon colors, printed ribbon designs, jump rings and event-ready packing.

Which finishes are common for award medals?

Gold, silver, bronze, antique gold, antique silver and dual plating are common choices for award medals.

Can race medals use custom shapes?

Yes. Race medals and event medallions can use round, shield, star or fully custom outlines based on artwork.

Medal order brief

Confirm the details that shape the finished medal.

Keep the artwork, award levels and distribution plan together before sample approval.

Shape and relief

Send the finished outline, dimensions and front or back artwork. Mark which details should be raised, recessed or printed.

Finish and color

Specify the gold, silver, bronze or antique look and identify any enamel or printed color areas separately.

Ribbon and packing

Confirm ribbon color, printed ribbon artwork, attachment style and whether medals need to be sorted by award level.
